# Make the transform use the rarest color as the motif color, then validate the received demo.
prog='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row:
            counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    color = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    if not cells:
        return g
    r0, c0 = min(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in cells]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sh, sw = max(r for r, c in shape)+1, max(c for r, c in shape)+1
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    g[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return g
'''
f.write_text(prog)
exec(prog)
